CALL is dominated by stack-extraction line.

rationale_summary: A5s SB closing-action squeeze vs HJ open + CO/BTN flats. rationale_summary: Hero has top-two-pair (Q's + J's) on Q83-J two-tone. Flop checkdown 5-way caps all ranges. BTN's turn bet is position-leveraged float (range-bet attempting to scoop dead pot). CALL acceptable mix to keep MP/CO in for river extraction; architect leans RAISE for protection on coordinated board.
